title: For each security group, return the security group ID and the total number
question: For each security group, return the security group ID and the total number of ports bound to it, considering only ports whose admin_state_up is 1, excluding ports on shared networks (i.e., networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), and only include security groups whose total bound-port count is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean bound-port count across all security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT sg.id AS sg_id, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt
  FROM securitygroups sg
  LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings b ON b.security_group_id = sg.id
  LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.id = b.port_id
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id FROM networkrbacs nr
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
  GROUP BY sg.id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS mean_cnt, STDDEV(cnt) AS sd_cnt FROM base
)
SELECT base.sg_id, base.cnt
FROM base, stats
WHERE base.cnt > stats.mean_cnt + stats.sd_cnt
ORDER BY base.sg_id;
